newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly up against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at 8.3059 against the U.S. dollar in listless trading on Thursday, from Wednesday's 8.3069, on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, traders said.
The yuan opened up at 8.3056 and consolidated between 8.3055 and 8.3060 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.3053 and a low of 8.3063.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3058, traders said.
Dealers said that the yuan was stable around 8.3060 on lack of market-moving news.
"The stability of the local unit was partly due to central bank intervention," one dealer said.
"The impact of cuts in interest rates last month has faded and the market needs fresh news." he added.
They expect the yuan to continue to consolidate around 8.3060 on Friday.
The yuan closed down slightly at 7.6151 from 7.5912 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0736 from 1.0745 against the Hong Kong dollar.
